name: @tzyc/dsh-model-visibility
description: Choose which models appear in the chat composer's model list, with per-provider groups, per-model capability tags sourced from the adapter, the relay model list, a built-in catalog, vendor corrections and manual overrides, separate coloured labels for image/video generation models, name search and capability filters, collapsible provider groups, a hard capability re-fetch, per-model overrides that can also be written back into the model provider's own settings, and an image-input alignment (on by default) for relay routes.
author: TZYCeng
